To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

ZE of proteins on a PMMA chip with conductivity detection is characterized by excellent migration times repeatabilities and good detection sensitivities, and that it is a suitable tool for the analysis of complex samples.

ZE separations of proteins with conductivity detection can be performed with a chip-to-chip reproducibility and a detection sensitivity that make the chip a promising tool in the field of microanalysis.

ZE separations of proteins with conductivity detection on a poly(methacrylate) microchip can be performed within 10 min with excellent repeatabilities and a macroconstituent/trace constituent ratio of 10000:1 can be attained.
